subject: HOF Gen6 P1 passive canonical wallpaper: remove second transition engine + exact right-pane mapping
body: Completed bounded SOURCE+MODEL lane against final-rechecked main 699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2. Current DuoWallpaperService directly owns HingeAngleSource, TiltFollower, DuoShader fold rendering and OverlayState coupling, so wallpaper remains a second transition engine. It also independently center-crops each panel, which breaks one-scene continuity. Proposed boundary: wallpaper becomes static/lifecycle-only; map image once into canonical INNER 1968x2184, then COVER uses exact right portal Rect(984,0,1920,2184) -> 1080x2520 at uniform 15/13. Gen6 renderer remains sole fold-animation and 120Hz lease owner. Model PASS: 100,000 randomized geometry cases + 100,000 lifecycle cases; static contract gate PASS with zero forbidden authority tokens and 12/12 required diagnostic markers. Adjacent newer peer claims own FIRST_USEFUL/FIRST_INTERACTIVE bridge-release policy; this handoff intentionally does not duplicate that work. No production writes; Android compile and Fold7 physical orientation/visual validation remain required.
